newsitem.title: USA: Remington Arms extends debt exchange offer.
newsitem.headline: Remington Arms extends debt exchange offer.

text.p: Remington Arms Co Inc and its parent RACI Holding Inc said Wednesday they had extended their offer to exchange up to $100 million aggregate principal amount of Remington's 9-1/2 percent senior subordinated notes due 2003, Series B, for a like principal amount of Remington 9-1/2 percent senior subordinated notes due 2003, Series A.
Remington extended the offer until 1700 EDT/2100 GMT today. It had been scheduled to expire June 16.
As of the close of the business June 16, about $99.2 million in aggregate principal amount of Series A notes had been tendered for exchange.
